description: Scans text (source code, test fixtures, logs, seed data) for card numbers that may be REAL: Luhn-valid, a known brand, and not a published sandbox number. Findings are masked (first 6 + last 4; last 4 only under 16 digits) and include line and column. Detects digits that are contiguous or grouped by single spaces or dashes; numbers split across lines or by dots are not detected. Pass the file contents as text; this server never reads files. Limits: 200000 characters per call, 50 findings shown.

text.description: Text to scan, e.g. a file's contents.

name: scan_for_real_cards
title: Scan text for real card numbers
